text: Ultra-wide 16:9 cinematic science-fiction matte painting, photorealistic detail, teal-and-orange palette. At twilight, rippled orange desert dunes fill the foreground, with windblown sand and long shadows. On a dune at lower left, seen from behind, stand exactly one shaggy beige-gray llama and one dark-haired person in a flowing ankle-length burgundy cape; both face a distant city. The futuristic oasis city sits center-right: dense low buildings and tiered circular complexes outlined in cyan and magenta, supporting three sleek glass needle skyscrapers. The tallest central teal tower has a brilliant horizontal turquoise neon halo near its tip; the left tower displays the vertical cyan text “OASIS”; the right tower glows violet-pink. Above, a deep navy starry sky gradients through purple and dusty blue to a peach-orange horizon, with a large slender silver crescent moon in the upper left and three diagonal cyan searchlight beams crossing the sky. At lower right, a small sleek cyan train travels on a single elevated golden light-rail track that S-curves from the bottom-right corner toward the city, supported by dark pylons. Behind it lies an irregular luminous turquoise pond. A tall dark-green saguaro cactus with two raised arms and pink neon rim lighting stands in front of the pond at the far right; one tiny distant cactus appears farther right. Atmospheric haze, glowing reflections, dramatic scale, soft cinematic lighting, crisp intricate details, no border.
